offering_description.value: Makes and sells refrigerated, minimally processed fresh dog and cat food and treats to pet owners through retailers and online, produced in its own US plants.

primary_products.value: fresh refrigerated dog food; fresh refrigerated cat food; refrigerated dog treats

customer_segment.value: B2C: pet owners buying fresh food for dogs and cats; B2B: grocery, mass, pet specialty and online retailers

end_markets.value: pet food; pet specialty retail; grocery retail; e-commerce

revenue_model.value: product sales: refrigerated pet food and treats sold to retailers and online

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: cooks and packages its own fresh pet food from meat and produce inputs, sold to retailers; brand owner: designs and markets its own pet food brands to pet owners

geography_served.value: US national: sold across the United States, with smaller sales in Canada

specialization.value: niche specialist: refrigerated fresh pet food for dogs, cats and treats

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams selling to national and regional retail chains; third-party retail: grocery, mass merchant and pet specialty stores; online: online pet retailers and retailer websites

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: pet food labeling and safety rules from FDA, AAFCO and state feed control agencies
